_comment: M9 Task 9.3 alerts as code: applied by scripts/splunk/apply.py (Splunk REST saved/searches). Each runs every minute over the last 5 complete minutes, is tracked in Activity > Triggered Alerts, and is suppressed for 10 minutes after firing. Thresholds and SLO reasoning: docs/operations/slo.md. What to do: the runbook link in each description.

alerts.name: mortgage_dev - Payment API 5xx rate above 5%
alerts.search: index=mortgage_dev message=http_request service.name=mortgage-service http.method=POST http.route="/api/v1/mortgages/{id}/payments" | eval bad=if('http.status'>=500,1,0) | stats count as total, sum(bad) as errors | eval error_rate=round(errors/total*100,2) | where total>=5 AND error_rate>5
alerts.description: Payments are failing: more than 5% of POST /payments returned 5xx in 5 minutes (10x the 0.5% error budget of the 99.5% SLO).

alerts.name: mortgage_dev - Payment API p95 latency above 500 ms
alerts.search: index=mortgage_dev message=http_request service.name=mortgage-service http.method=POST http.route="/api/v1/mortgages/{id}/payments" | stats count as total, perc95(durationMs) as p95 | eval p95=round(p95,1) | where total>=5 AND p95>500
alerts.description: Payments are slow: p95 of POST /payments above 500 ms over 5 minutes (latency SLO).

alerts.name: mortgage_dev - Error spike in a service
alerts.search: index=mortgage_dev log.level=ERROR | stats count as errors, dc(correlationId) as requests, latest(message) as last_error by service.name | where errors>=10
alerts.description: A service logged 10 or more ERROR lines in 5 minutes (database or broker down, bad deployment, poison message).
